# W7B: Design Applicator

## Purpose
Applies design decisions (colors, fonts, layout) to marketing assets.
Takes existing teaser package and regenerates with branding applied.

## Input
```json
{
  "productId": "prod_123",
  "design": {
    "theme": "luxury",
    "colors": {
      "primary": "#7c3aed",
      "secondary": "#5b21b6",
      "accent": "#a78bfa",
      "bg": "#faf5ff",
      "text": "#1f2937"
    },
    "font": "classic",
    "fontConfig": {
      "heading": "Playfair Display",
      "body": "Source Sans Pro"
    },
    "layout": "centered"
  }
}
```

## Output
- styled_landing_page.html
- styled_email_template.html
- social_media_templates.json
- brand_guidelines.json

## Cost: ~$0.02-0.04 per application
